checks: both migrations execute without changing existing table identities
shared draft orders can include unlisted models without allocating stock
unvalidated execution and validated unknown models reject atomically
viewer and unrelated user cannot save the organization workspace
authenticated and anonymous roles cannot claim outbound deliveries
server claim creates one durable in-flight record and blocks duplicate claims
same request ID cannot be rebound to a different payload hash
acknowledged and uncertain deliveries never claim another send
known rejected requests allow bounded retries with the same payload
delivery reads are organization-scoped and client writes are denied
method: Migrations and role/RLS/RPC behavior executed in isolated PGlite 0.3.14 PostgreSQL. Synthetic auth schema and principals. No live Supabase or partner service.
